title: Documentation acceptance plan
lead: Judge whether the reader is comfortable to use and whether it reports your observations accurately.

identity.readiness: Render all three example files together. Human acceptance has not been recorded.

overview.text: This plan tests the generated documentation reader's appearance, navigation and summary generation. It does not accept features in another application. The journeys begin Untested; record your own judgment after performing them.

items: Render examples/set.json with the --set option to include all three guides in the same generated set.
Open uat.html in your browser. Keep this tab open; no account or external service is required.
Have a local scratch document available to check pasted summary text.

setup.title: Navigation during testing
setup.text: Links to the technical reference and user guide open in a new tab, keeping this plan and its results open.

tests.title: Read in both themes
tests.brief: Judge text readability and visible focus in the dark and light appearances.

prerequisites.text: Use this plan. No additional data is needed.

steps: Choose Dark in Appearance. Read the test and use Tab to move through its result controls.
Choose Light. Read the same text and inspect the notes field.
Return to the appearance you prefer.
tests.expected: Text, controls and focus indicators remain readable. The wordmark suits each background.
tests.problemSigns: Invisible focus, unreadable text or a wordmark that disappears.
tests.reset: Choose System to restore the device preference.
tests.rehearsal: No rehearsal claim is embedded in this reusable example. Check the current package verification report separately.

tests.title: Find a topic
tests.brief: Judge whether the topic menu gets you to the requested information.

prerequisites.text: Open the companion user-guide.html in a separate tab. Search text: appearance.

steps: Type appearance in Find in this document in the user guide.
Choose Choose your appearance in the matching menu.
Press Escape in the search field to restore the full menu. Return to the UAT tab.
tests.expected: The matching topic opens. Clearing search restores all topics. On a narrow screen, search opens the menu and choosing a topic closes it.
tests.problemSigns: A missing match, the wrong destination or an inaccessible mobile menu.
tests.reset: Clear the search; this journey does not modify other test data.
tests.rehearsal: No rehearsal claim is embedded in this reusable example.

tests.title: Generate useful results
tests.brief: Judge whether the summary contains your latest observations and copies in one action.

prerequisites.text: Use this plan and a local scratch document. Example note: Theme labels are clear. Clipboard permission may be allowed or blocked by your browser.

steps: Enter the example note before choosing a result.
Go to Summary and select Generate summary. If copying is allowed, paste into the scratch document.
Check that the summary includes every test ID, five result counts, the plan identity and your note.
Return to this test and record your actual result. Generate again to include that final choice.
tests.expected: One action generates and copies current results. If copying is denied, text remains visible and selected with an accurate message. Editing a result or note marks the old summary stale.
tests.problemSigns: Missing notes, wrong counts, false copy confirmation or a required separate Copy summary action.
tests.reset: Clear the example note or change the result to Untested if you were only exploring the controls.
tests.rehearsal: No rehearsal claim is embedded in this reusable example.
